name: Cold War
description: New Year 1962: the Berlin Wall is months old, Cuba has declared for socialism, Algeria and the Congo are in turmoil and the European empires are in their last years, while NATO and the Warsaw Pact face each other across a divided Germany.
approximations: Borders follow modern admin-1 provinces: Berlin is drawn wholly as East German, Vietnam is split at province level near the 17th parallel, Kashmir follows the 1949 ceasefire line only roughly, and the Gaza Strip and small enclaves are not shown. Colonies and protectorates still held on 1 January 1962 belong to their metropole (British East Africa, Aden and the Gulf, Portuguese Africa, Algeria, Rwanda-Urundi, West New Guinea, Spanish Sahara); the Central African Federation is a British subject and Katanga is shown as the secessionist state it then was. Population, GDP (Maddison-style 1990 international dollars, including colonies for the empires) and army sizes are rounded estimates; Soviet-bloc and Chinese output is especially uncertain.
